documents.title: Chapter 15.58: Special Events on Private Property
documents.notes: Functions as Fullerton's private-property TUP-equivalent chapter. Fee amounts NOT included in ordinance text - set by separate City Council resolution.

documents.title: Chapter 8.71: Special Events on Public Streets and Public Facilities
documents.notes: Parallel track to 15.58 for events on public property/streets. Cross-referenced by 15.58.030(C). Fee amounts NOT included - set by City Council resolution.

documents.title: Chapter 15.70: Conditional Use Permits
documents.notes: Relevant to test question on CUP amendments for venues exceeding approved event counts. Fee amounts NOT included - set by City Council resolution.
